name: SICK
source:
I’ve lost pieces of my family one by one. Memories, trust, sanity. Now I face a choice that could destroy or save what little remains… but at what cost?

[From [url=https://splatterrat.itch.io/sick]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我已经一一失去了我的家人。记忆、信任、理智。现在我面临着一个选择，可能会摧毁或拯救仅存的一点点……但代价是什么？

[来自[url=https://splatterrat.itch.io/sick]Itch.io[/url]]
